branchApplicability.rationale: USDM has no borrower-specific collateral or liquidation branches, but Monetrix's protocol-wide strategy buys an equivalent dollar amount of spot assets, opens equal short perpetual positions, and actively reallocates among yield sources. Those dollar-valued hedge construction and rebalancing decisions require a price-sensitive top-level authority, whose feed topology and failover remain unpublished.
